## Same Day — Critical

### Alert #41 — `shell-quote` CVE-2026-9277

**Severity:** CRITICAL (CVSS 4.0: 9.2) / HIGH (CVSS 3.1: 8.1)
**Package:** `shell-quote <= 1.8.3` → fix `1.8.4`
**Manifest:** `ui/package-lock.json` (transitive)
**Component:** UI build toolchain / CI-CD pipeline
**Status:** ✅ Applied 2026-06-23 — override added to `ui/package.json`

`shell-quote`'s `quote()` does not escape newline characters in object `.op` values. A string containing `\n` can break out of a quoted argument and inject arbitrary shell commands. Azure Pipelines passes branch and PR metadata into pipeline variables — if any pipeline script passes that data through `env-cmd` or similar tooling that uses `shell-quote`, command injection in CI is possible.

**Production users are not affected** — `shell-quote` is not in the browser bundle or the Python backend.

**Fix:**

Add to `ui/package.json` `overrides`:
```json
"overrides": {
  "shell-quote": "^1.8.4"
}
```
Run `npm install` in `ui/`.

**Owner:** UI Agent
**References:** [NVD CVE-2026-9277](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-9277)

## Within 3 Business Days — High

### Alert #40 — `pyarrow` CVE-2026-25087

**Severity:** High
**Package:** `pyarrow==18.1.0` → fix `23.0.1`
**Manifest:** `docker/imageryprep/requirements.txt`
**Component:** imageryprep Docker container (Azure Batch)
**Status:** ⏳ Pending — awaiting imageryprep Docker build and pipeline smoke tests

Use-after-free when reading Arrow IPC files with pre-buffering enabled. The imageryprep container processes satellite imagery data; if Arrow/Parquet files are sourced from external providers or user datasets, a crafted file could trigger RCE inside the Azure Batch node, exposing MSI credentials.

This is a **major version jump** (18.x → 23.x). Breaking API changes are likely. Full imageryprep pipeline tests are mandatory before deploying.

**Fix:**
- Upgrade `pyarrow==18.1.0` → `pyarrow==23.0.1` in [docker/imageryprep/requirements.txt](../docker/imageryprep/requirements.txt)
- Add `pyarrow>=23.0.1` version floor in [hastelib/pyproject.toml](../hastelib/pyproject.toml)
- Run full imageryprep Docker build and pipeline smoke tests

**Owner:** Backend Dev Agent
**References:** [NVD CVE-2026-25087](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-25087) · [GHSA-rgxp-2hwp-jwgg](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rgxp-2hwp-jwgg)

### Alert #51 — `form-data` CVE-2026-12143

**Severity:** High
**Package:** `form-data >= 4.0.0, < 4.0.6` → fix `4.0.6`
**Manifest:** `ui/package-lock.json` (transitive)
**Component:** UI (production bundle status uncertain — needs audit)
**Status:** ✅ Override applied 2026-06-23 · Bundle audit complete — `form-data` is dev toolchain only (`@azure/static-web-apps-cli` → `wait-on` → `axios` → `form-data`). Not in production browser bundle. No runtime exposure.

CRLF injection via unescaped multipart field names and filenames. If `form-data` is in the production browser bundle and used for imagery uploads, a malicious filename with `\r\n` could inject HTTP headers into multipart requests sent to `hastefuncapi`.

**Before acting:** run `npm ls form-data` and `npm run build` (inspect `dist/`) to confirm whether `form-data` appears in the production bundle. If confirmed, treat as runtime and escalate.

**Fix:**
```json
"overrides": {
  "form-data": "^4.0.6"
}
```

**Owner:** UI Agent
**References:** [NVD CVE-2026-12143](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-12143) · [GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx)

### Alerts #53, #52, #55 — `undici` (3 CVEs)

**Severity:** High (#53) / Medium (#54) / Low (#52, #55)
**Package:** `undici < 6.27.0` → fix `6.27.0`
**Manifest:** `ui/package-lock.json` (transitive — SWA CLI / vite dev server)
**Component:** Dev/Node.js toolchain only — not in browser bundle
**Status:** ✅ Applied 2026-06-23 — override added to `ui/package.json`

All three CVEs are resolved by a single version bump. `undici` is a Node.js HTTP client that does not ship in the React production bundle.

| Alert | CVE | Severity | Description |
|-------|-----|----------|-------------|
| #53 | CVE-2026-12151 | High | WebSocket DoS via fragment count bypass |
| #54 | CVE-2026-9679 | Medium | HTTP header injection via Set-Cookie percent-decoding |
| #52 | CVE-2026-6733 | Low | HTTP response queue poisoning via keep-alive socket reuse |
| #55 | CVE-2026-11525 | Low | Set-Cookie SameSite attribute downgrade |

All four CVEs are resolved by a single version bump to `6.27.0`. The advisory ([GHSA-p88m-4jfj-68fv](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p88m-4jfj-68fv)) confirms affected versions include `< 6.27.0` for the 6.x branch — the Validation Agent was wrong that 6.x is unaffected.

> **Validation Agent error — confirmed by human review:** Alert #54 (CVE-2026-9679) was incorrectly rejected. The agent read only the "introduced in 7.0.0" summary line without checking the full affected version table. The GitHub Advisory ([GHSA-p88m-4jfj-68fv](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p88m-4jfj-68fv)) explicitly lists `< 6.27.0` as an affected range. Fix is `6.27.0` — the original Security Agent was correct. The agent definition has been updated to require reading full version range tables across all branches.

**Fix:**
```json
"overrides": {
  "undici": "^6.27.0"
}
```

**Owner:** UI Agent
**References:** [NVD CVE-2026-12151](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-12151) · [GHSA-p88m-4jfj-68fv](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p88m-4jfj-68fv)

### Alerts #46, #47 — `vite` CVE-2026-53571

**Severity:** High
**Package:** `vite >= 8.0.0, <= 8.0.15` → fix `8.0.16`
**Manifests:** `ui/package-lock.json` + root `package-lock.json`
**Component:** Dev server (Windows developer machines only — zero production impact)
**Status:** ✅ Applied 2026-06-23 — `vite` bumped to `^8.0.16` in `ui/package.json` and root `package.json`

`server.fs.deny` can be bypassed on Windows using alternate path representations (8.3 short names, trailing dots, case variations) to read files outside the sandbox. Only exploitable against a locally running `vite dev` server.

**Fix:** Upgrade `vite` to `^8.0.16` in both [ui/package.json](../ui/package.json) and root [package.json](../package.json).

**Owner:** UI Agent
**References:** [NVD CVE-2026-53571](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-53571)

### Alerts #44, #45 — `launch-editor` CVE-2026-53632

**Severity:** Medium
**Package:** `launch-editor < 2.14.1` → fix `2.14.1`
**Manifests:** `ui/package-lock.json` + root `package-lock.json`
**Component:** Dev server (Windows developer machines only)
**Status:** ✅ Applied 2026-06-23 — override added to `ui/package.json` and root `package.json`

NTLMv2 hash disclosure via UNC path handling on Windows. A malicious page can get the dev server to resolve a `\\server\share` path, triggering SMB authentication that leaks the developer's NTLMv2 credentials to an attacker-controlled server.

> **Correction from validation:** Security Agent attributed this to `vite`. Validation identified the actual vulnerable package as **`launch-editor`**. The vite upgrade (CVE-2026-53571) does not necessarily close this. A separate `launch-editor` override is required.

**Fix:**
```json
"overrides": {
  "launch-editor": "^2.14.1"
}
```

**Owner:** UI Agent
**References:** [NVD CVE-2026-53632](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-53632) · [GHSA-v6wh-96g9-6wx3](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-v6wh-96g9-6wx3)

## Next Sprint — Medium

### Alert #49 — `js-yaml` CVE-2026-53550

**Severity:** Medium (CVSS 3.1: 5.3)
**Package:** `js-yaml <= 4.1.1` → fix `4.2.0`
**Manifest:** `ui/package-lock.json` (direct dep)
**Component:** UI — **confirmed in production browser bundle**
**Status:** ✅ Applied 2026-06-23 — bumped to `^4.2.0` in `ui/package.json`

Quadratic-complexity DoS in YAML merge key handling. A crafted YAML input with deeply nested aliases causes the parser to exhaust CPU. `js-yaml ^4.1.1` is a direct dependency in `ui/package.json` and ships in the production bundle.

> **Correction from validation:** Security Agent classified bundle status as "uncertain." Validation confirmed `js-yaml` is a direct production dep.

**Fix:** Upgrade `js-yaml` to `^4.2.0` in [ui/package.json](../ui/package.json).

**Owner:** UI Agent
**References:** [NVD CVE-2026-53550](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-53550)

### Alert #43 — `joi` CVE-2026-48038

**Severity:** Medium (CVSS 3.1: 5.3)
**Package:** `joi >= 18.0.0, < 18.2.1` or `< 17.13.4` → fix `18.2.1` / `17.13.4`
**Manifest:** `ui/package-lock.json` (transitive)
**Component:** UI (bundle status needs verification)
**Advisory:** [GHSA-q7cg-457f-vx79](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q7cg-457f-vx79)
**Status:** ✅ Override applied 2026-06-23 · Bundle audit complete — `joi` is dev toolchain only (`@azure/static-web-apps-cli` → `wait-on` → `joi`). Not in production browser bundle. No runtime exposure.

Uncaught `RangeError` on deeply nested input via recursive `link()` schemas. A `validate()` call without `try/catch` in a request handler would throw an unhandled exception and crash the process. If `joi` is in the production browser bundle and used for client-side validation, a malicious user can submit a deeply nested object to trigger this.

> **Validation Agent error — confirmed by human review:** The agent initially reported this CVE as unverifiable after only checking NVD. Human review confirmed it at [GHSA-q7cg-457f-vx79](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q7cg-457f-vx79) (published 2026-05-20). The Security Validation Agent definition has been updated to require checking both NVD and GHSA independently.

**Fix:**
```json
"overrides": {
  "joi": "^17.13.4"
}
```
Run `npm ls joi` to identify the direct dep pulling it and confirm whether it appears in the production bundle.

**Owner:** UI Agent
**References:** [GHSA-q7cg-457f-vx79](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q7cg-457f-vx79) · [hapijs/joi#3113](https://github.com/hapijs/joi/pull/3113)

### Alerts #33, #34, #38 — GDAL (3 CVEs) ⚠️ Severity Understated

**Dependabot Severity:** Low
**NIST NVD Severity:** HIGH (7.8) for CVE-2026-8087; Medium for others
**Package:** `gdal==3.9.2` → fix in `3.13.x` line
**Manifests:** `hastelib/pyproject.toml`, `api/hastefuncapi/requirements.txt`, `api/hastefuncqueues/requirements.txt`, `docker/imageryprep/requirements.txt`
**Component:** hastelib (all geospatial processing) + imageryprep container
**Status:** ⏳ Pending — dependency exception with compensating controls

Three memory-safety vulnerabilities in GDAL 3.9.2:

| Alert | CVE | NIST Severity | Description | First patched version |
|-------|-----|---------------|-------------|-----------------------|
| `#34` | CVE-2026-8087 | **HIGH 7.8** | Heap-based buffer overflow in HDF4/EOS `GDnentries` | 3.13.0 |
| `#33` | CVE-2026-8088 | Medium 5.5 | Out-of-bounds read in `GDfieldinfo` | 3.13.0 |
| `#38` | CVE-2026-8212 | Medium 5.5 | Out-of-bounds read in `SWSDfldsrch` (Dependabot: heap overflow — NIST classifies as OOB read) | 3.13.0rc1 (3.13.0 also satisfies) |

> **Warning:** Dependabot rates these LOW but NIST rates CVE-2026-8087 at **7.8 HIGH**. GDAL processes satellite imagery from external sources throughout `hastelib`. File parsing vulnerabilities in GDAL are a realistic attack vector — a malicious GeoTIFF/HDF4 file delivered via imagery provider API could exploit these. Do not treat as routine backlog without a tracked plan.

**Upgrade constraint:** HASTE depends on externally hosted Linux pip wheels for GDAL. A trusted prebuilt pip wheel source for the patched GDAL 3.13 line is not currently available for HASTE runtime constraints.

**Recommended action (no wheel ownership path):**

- Keep alerts #33, #34, and #38 in a documented dependency exception state.
- Enforce compensating controls: authenticated allowlisted providers/endpoints, pre-parse format filtering, strict size/type checks, and SSRF/redirect guards.
- Re-evaluate weekly for upstream trusted wheels or a deployment-model change that removes the pip wheel dependency.

**Implementation status (bottom line):**

- Fully implemented today: URL allowlist enforcement plus SSRF/redirect guards on the custom-footprint fetch path.
- Partially implemented today: authenticated-source guarantees and strict size/type validation across all ingestion boundaries.


**Owner:** GIS Agent + Backend Dev Agent
**References:** [NVD CVE-2026-8087](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-8087) · [NVD CVE-2026-8088](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-8088) · [NVD CVE-2026-8212](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-8212)

## Validation Notes

This report incorporates corrections from the Security Validation Agent, with two errors subsequently identified and confirmed during human review. The agent definition ([.github/agents/security-validation.agent.md](../.github/agents/security-validation.agent.md)) was updated to prevent recurrence.

### Confirmed Validation Agent Errors (caught during human review)

1. **CVE-2026-9679 (undici, Alert #54) — incorrectly rejected.** Agent read only the "introduced in 7.0.0" summary line and concluded 6.x was unaffected. Full advisory ([GHSA-p88m-4jfj-68fv](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p88m-4jfj-68fv)) lists `< 6.27.0` as a separate affected range. Alert is valid; fix is `6.27.0`. **Agent definition updated** to require reading all version range rows across all branches.

2. **CVE-2026-48038 (joi, Alert #43) — incorrectly declared unverifiable.** Agent searched NVD only; NVD had not yet propagated the entry. GHSA had it at [GHSA-q7cg-457f-vx79](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q7cg-457f-vx79) (published 2026-05-20). Alert is valid. **Agent definition updated** to require checking both NVD and GHSA independently, and to never declare a CVE unverifiable after checking only one source.

### Confirmed Validation Agent Corrections (accurate)

3. **CVE-2026-53632 — wrong package attributed by Security Agent.** Actual vulnerable package is `launch-editor`, not `vite`. Fix requires a separate `launch-editor: ^2.14.1` override. Confirmed via [GHSA-v6wh-96g9-6wx3](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-v6wh-96g9-6wx3).

4. **CVE-2026-40181 (react-router, Alert #39) — not applicable, closed by upgrade.** Advisory scopes vulnerability to `redirect()` in data-mode routing; HASTE uses `<BrowserRouter>` and is categorically exempt. Rather than dismissing the alert, `react-router-dom` was upgraded to `^6.30.4` to close it cleanly with no dismissal record to maintain.

5. **undici fix version** was `6.27.0` in the Security Agent (correct). Validation Agent changed to `6.26.0` (wrong). Reverted after GHSA verification.

6. **GDAL severity.** Dependabot rates all three GDAL CVEs as LOW. NIST NVD rates CVE-2026-8087 at **7.8 HIGH**. Escalated accordingly.

7. **js-yaml production impact.** Security Agent marked bundle status as "uncertain." Validation confirmed it is a direct dep in `ui/package.json` and ships in the production bundle.
